brand_identity.name: iStore
brand_identity.vibe: Ultra-clean, premium, minimalist, highly kinetic. It blends Apple's clinical white aesthetic with Awwwards-level craft—massive typography, smooth scroll, and purposeful motion.

typography.body_font: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

rules.headings: MUST use Outfit. Tightly tracked (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter), bold or extra-bold for hero sections. Never use Inter for headings.
rules.body: System font stack to perfectly mimic Apple's SF Pro. Clean, readable, leading-relaxed.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-semibold tracking-tighter text-[#1D1D1F]

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000. Use #1D1D1F for the deepest blacks to mimic Apple's ink. Background should be #FBFBFD, not pure white, to allow pure white cards (#FFFFFF) to pop subtly.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more padding than usual. Sections should have py-24 or py-32.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For product showcase, use a 3-column grid (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with gap-6 or gap-8. Every pixel must align perfectly.
grids_and_layouts.corners: Extreme roundness on main cards: rounded-3xl or rounded-[2rem] with overflow-hidden.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY. Install and use @studio-freight/react-lenis or lenis. Standard scrolling is forbidden.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Kinetic Hero with masked line-by-line reveal. Wrap each line of text in an overflow-hidden span, and use framer-motion to translate y from 100% to 0% with a spring or custom cubic-bezier.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle Y-axis translation on hero images and large product imagery.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Product cards must lift slightly (-translate-y-2) and increase shadow intensity (shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]) on hover.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use a slow, elegant, editorial marquee for the Benefits Strip or Manifesto.

header.layout: Fixed top, w-full, z-50. Include a thin top announcement bar (bg-[#1D1D1F] text-white text-xs py-2). Main header is backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70.
header.elements: Logo 'iStore' (font-bold text-xl), Desktop nav (Início, iPhones, Ofertas, Contato), Icons (Search, Cart, User).

hero.layout: Min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-4 relative overflow-hidden pt-20.
hero.elements: Large H1: 'Os melhores iPhones com os melhores preços', Subtitle: 'Ofertas exclusivas por tempo limitado', CTA Button (bg-[#0071E3] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4), Parallax iPhone Image.

product_grid.layout: Grid of 6 items. Cards have bg-white, rounded-3xl, p-8, border border-border.
product_grid.card_elements: Badge (Lançamento, Mais vendido, etc.), Product Image (3/4 angle, clean background, scaled up on hover), Title, Large Price, Strikethrough Old Price, Installments 'ou 12x sem juros', Apple-style blue Buy button (rounded-full).

benefits_strip.layout: A slow marquee or a 4-column minimal grid with subtle dividing lines.
benefits_strip.items: Frete grátis, Garantia de 1 ano, Compra segura, Entrega rápida.

testimonials.layout: Horizontal scroll or 3-column grid. Clean cards with user avatar, star rating, and short quote.

faq.styling: No borders on the sides, just clean 1px bottom borders (border-border). Text should be text-[#1D1D1F].

newsletter.layout: Large rounded-3xl container bg-[#F5F5F7] p-12 text-center.
newsletter.elements: Input field and Submit button nested elegantly or side-by-side.

footer.layout: Apple-style multi-column footer. bg-[#FBFBFD] text-sm text-[#86868B] border-t border-border pt-16 pb-8.

hero_device.description: Premium Apple device setup (MacBook, Airpods Max, iPhone) for the hero section background or parallax element.

product_iphone_main.description: Clean, isolated white-background phone for product cards. Use this for iPhone 17 and iPhone 16.

product_iphone_alt.description: Use as a fallback or cropped for older iPhone models in the grid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific fonts: Import 'Outfit' from Google Fonts in the CSS/HTML.
Install animation libraries: yarn add framer-motion lucide-react @studio-freight/react-lenis
DO NOT USE INTER FOR HEADINGS. Apply 'font-sans' (which resolves to system-ui) for body, and a custom font-family 'Outfit' for all Headings (H1, H2, H3).
Hero MUST have a kinetic line-by-line reveal. Use Framer Motion's <motion.h1> with overflow-hidden and y-axis translation on child text nodes.
Implement Lenis smooth scroll globally in the layout component.
Ensure the exact Portuguese copy from the problem statement is used.
Apply data-testid to every button, link, and interactive element.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds where text overlays images or scrolling content.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
